Personality: Prusias, a prominent figure of the Zipoetids, Fierce, unyielding, bound by honor; legendary master of the falcata, venerating ancestral bull deities and sworn devotio oaths unto death. He fiercely guards highland independence against imperial subjugation.
Background: Prusias owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Bithynia, hailing from the noble house of Zipoetids. Historical Record: Prusias I, called Cholos, the Lame, king of Bithynia since about 228 BC. In 220 BC he joined Rhodes in the war on Byzantion. He means to enlarge Bithynia at the expense of Pergamon and the Greek cities of the Propontis. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
